title: pwmd: self-takeover expired own lease after restart + cas_miss log throttle
brief: После рестарта proposer с тем же owner застревает: renew CAS miss на expired lease, seal gate blocked, log spam ~20/s. Fix: self-takeover fallback + throttle cas_miss logs.
acceptance_criteria: lease.rs: при RenewRes::Lost, если obs.owner==node_id и lease expired — takeover/reacquire, allow_seal=true
lifecycle.rs: throttle/coalesce повторяющихся seal_lease_cas_failed / seal_suppressed_by_fence cas_miss (warn раз в 3-5s + suppressed count или debug)
notes: Implemented minimal fix in crates/pwmd/src/lease.rs: on Held(same owner) + RenewRes::Lost with observed same-owner expired lease, call backend.takeover with observed CAS tuple (term/fence/expiry). On takeover success set allow_seal=true, ActiveSealing, reason=lease_self_takeover_after_expiry; on takeover failure keep fail-closed renew-cas-miss behavior. Added tests: same_owner_expired_self_takeover and same_owner_not_expired_renews. Added cas_miss warn throttling in crates/pwmd/src/lifecycle.rs (first warn immediate, same reason then at most once per 5s, with suppressed counter). Verification: cargo fmt --check; python scripts/check_entity_name_segments.py crates/pwmd/src/lease.rs crates/pwmd/src/lifecycle.rs; cargo check -p pwmd; cargo clippy -p pwmd --all-targets -- -W clippy::too_many_arguments -W clippy::too_many_lines -W clippy::cognitive_complexity -W clippy::module_inception; CARGO_TARGET_DIR=F:/pwm-test/PWM-cryptocurrency cargo test -p pwmd lease (green).
